UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; curl -fL --retry 3 -o run-node.sh \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkolk/AMPTemplates/main/k3snoderun.sh\"; chmod +x run-node.sh; echo \"launcher refreshed\""

-c "set -e; fail=0; command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo \"MISSING: docker is not installed on this host.\" >&2; fail=1; }; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo \"MISSING: cannot reach the Docker daemon - add the AMP user to the docker group and restart AMP. See k3snodeREADME.md step 2.\" >&2; fail=1; }; test -r /etc/amp-k3s/secrets.env || { echo \"MISSING: /etc/amp-k3s/secrets.env is not readable by the AMP user. See k3snodeREADME.md step 1.\" >&2; fail=1; }; command -v tailscale >/dev/null || { echo \"MISSING: tailscale is not installed on this host. See k3snodeREADME.md step 3.\" >&2; fail=1; }; TSIP=$(tailscale ip -4 2>/dev/null | head -1) || true; if [ -n \"$TSIP\" ]; then echo \"Tailscale IPv4: $TSIP  <- put this in Extra Agent Arguments as --node-ip and --kubelet-arg=address\"; else echo \"MISSING: this host is not on the tailnet (tailscale up --accept-routes). See k3snodeREADME.md step 3.\" >&2; fail=1; fi; case \"{{ExtraAgentArgs}}\" in *TAILSCALE_IP*) echo \"ACTION REQUIRED: Extra Agent Arguments still contains the TAILSCALE_IP placeholder. Until you replace it, this node will register its PUBLIC IP and expose the kubelet on port 10250 to the internet.\" >&2; fail=1;; esac; test \"$fail\" = 0 && echo \"Preflight OK - host prerequisites are in place.\"; exit 0"

-c "set -e; echo \"Checking reachability of {{K3sServerURL}} via the subnet router\"; curl -ksS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w \"control plane responded: HTTP %{http_code}\\n\" \"{{K3sServerURL}}/ping\" || echo \"WARNING: could not reach {{K3sServerURL}}. Check that the in-cluster subnet router advertises 192.168.2.0/24 and that this host ran tailscale up --accept-routes.\" >&2; exit 0"
